purpose: Teach: 熟語/官能/固体/開校/国体/農耕/高分子/感嘆

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、四字熟語の認知研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on four-character idioms and cognitive research, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, measured opening. Steady eye contact. Slight upward lilt at the end—genuine curiosity, not testing. Patient pause before speaking, as if giving him space to land his answer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、文学における官能描写の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on sensory descriptions in literature.
lines.style: Quiet correction, not defensive. Slight hesitation at the start—gathering his words. Even pacing. Direct but soft. The tone of someone used to gentle misunderstandings and choosing not to mind them.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、固体物理学の最新研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on the latest research in solid-state physics, wasn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, observant. Slight tilt of the head. The tone of someone watching carefully, genuinely curious about where the thread leads. Warm but not leading.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦後の新制中学校の開校史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the history of new post-war junior high school openings.
lines.style: Patient correction again. Same quiet cadence. A beat of acceptance before speaking. No edge—just clarifying. The small kindness of not making her feel bad for asking.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国体明徴運動の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote your paper on the history of the Kokutai Meisho movement, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged but not pushy. Slight forward lean in the voice—genuine interest in the topic itself. Warm recognition that this is a substantial subject. Open invitation to elaborate.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、縄文期農耕の起源を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the origins of agriculture in the Jomon period.
lines.style: Same gentle correction. A breath before the subject. Steady, unrushed. The tone of someone who has explained this a few times and is still patient about it. No frustration, just clarity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、高分子化学の最新動向を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, didn't you write your paper on the latest developments in polymer chemistry?
lines.style: Reflective, observant. Slight pause before the question—as if mentally reviewing. Warm recognition of the topic's weight. The tone of someone who reads carefully and wants to get it right.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、芸術鑑賞時の感嘆表現を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on expressions of admiration when experiencing art.
lines.style: Final gentle correction. Same measured breath. Slightly softer close—a note of quiet completion. Not tired, just settled. The tone of finishing a kind explanation with grace.
